responsibility: Declares `CollectLangItems`, an AST visitor pass for the Rust frontend that collects `#[lang = ...]` definitions ahead of lowering and inserts them into `Analysis::Mappings`. The header provides the crate entry point, keeps the shared HIR/name-resolution mapping table reference, and declares the `visit` hooks for item kinds that may carry lang-item attributes, defining the interface for this early semantic discovery pass rather than the general attribute AST model itself.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `CollectLangItems` visitor, its crate-level `go` entry point, mapping-table state, and the item visitor hooks that may collect lang items. Unlike the paired `.cc` file, this header defines the pass interface and eligible visitation surface, not the attribute-reading and mapping-insertion implementation.
